text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Joint operations by the Mozambican and South African police forces to recover cars stolen in South Africa are being carried out in the central Mozambican cities of Beira, Chimoio and Tete, amidst allegations of arbitary arrests and seizures of vehicles without warrants.
- The flood crisis on the Pungwe river in central Mozambique has worsened and 2,000 families have fled their submerged homes for higher ground. Seven people have drowned.
